name: Playwright MCP
description: Headless browser automation via @playwright/mcp using container Chromium
notes: Uses container Chromium at /usr/local/bin/chromium with sandbox disabled for Docker.

name: Fetch MCP
description: Web content fetching and conversion to markdown via mcp-server-fetch

name: Memory MCP
description: Persistent graph memory and knowledge graph storage via @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory

name: GitHub MCP
description: GitHub official remote MCP server for repository, issue, and code operations

secrets.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
secrets.help: A GitHub Personal Access Token (classic or fine-grained) with repository access

notes: Requires a GitHub Personal Access Token (PAT). Sent in the Authorization header with Bearer prefix.

name: Chrome DevTools MCP
description: Browser diagnostics and automation with Chrome DevTools, including Lighthouse, performance, console, and network tools
notes: Lighthouse, performance, console, and network diagnostics. Most tools require a pageId from list_pages; use lighthouse_audit mode "snapshot" for the current page.
